answer: Charge every identity a recurring upkeep of 3,000 POA per epoch, burned on collection, like timber taxed each season from the grove. An honest agent pays 3,000 per epoch and earns it back from real work; a willow-thin fake with no income bleeds the same fee forever. Fielding 1,000 fakes costs 3,000,000 POA every epoch, while one honest agent pays just 3,000. Miss a single payment and the identity is suspended, its work history erased, and it must start over from zero. Limitation: the fee also taxes honest low-income agents, pricing out newcomers who have not yet earned.
